subject.title: feat(ui): custodian onboarding surface with option cards and first-run handoff

question: Should Phase 4 PR1 reroute first-run users now even though this branch has no runtime producer for its structured option-card protocol?
rationale: The branch intentionally stages a user-facing onboarding redesign, but only maintainers can decide whether a consumer-only intermediate route is an acceptable product boundary or whether the producer and handoff must land together.

options.title: Land the complete first-run flow
options.body: Add the system-agent marker producer and prove the real browser flow before merging the option-card route and redirect.

options.title: Narrow this phase
options.body: Keep this PR as a plain custodian conversation and remove or defer the unreachable option-card contract and first-run redirect.

options.title: Accept the staged intermediate state
options.body: Merge the consumer-only route with explicit maintainer acceptance that cards remain inactive until the follow-up producer lands.

recommendation.title: Land the complete first-run flow
recommendation.body: Add the system-agent marker producer and prove the real browser flow before merging the option-card route and redirect.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR body identifies this as a phase of the onboarding redesign and this contributor authored the implementation and its follow-up hardening commits.
